verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hands photo to a tiny thumbnail with a stray cloud/cross strip floating beside it, leaves huge empty white areas, and inverts the hierarchy: 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' is set smaller than 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!'. B keeps the photo at a usable size and sets the headline larger than the subhead, but the reading order is wrong (the subhead sits above the image and the headline below it). Its cloud and cross fragments are also scattered along the bottom edge, and the big dead gaps lose the original's dark full-bleed feel.
